name: Grand Prix 5000

origin.basis: Continental's bicycle tires are marketed from its German site; Germany-made lines are marked 'Handmade in Germany'.

positioning: Tube-type version of the Grand Prix 5000 for riders who keep inner tubes.
weight_basis: Continental black-sidewall claims; transparent and cream sidewalls weigh 5-45 g more.
pressure_note: The product table does not list maximum pressures for this tube-type tire; use the figure printed on the tire.

availability.note: Continental's official Tmall store sells it in mainland China; Continental's German and US catalogs list it for retailers.

price_observations.market: Continental official Tmall store (德国马牌轮胎官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China.

caveats: Needs an inner tube; lab rolling resistance is with a butyl tube and changes with the tube you choose.
Hookless rim use is not stated; follow the rim maker, which normally requires hookless-approved tubeless tires.
